title: Army Evacuates Over 790 People from Flood-Hit Areas in Gujarat
summary: The Indian Army has evacuated over 790 people from flood-hit areas in Gujarat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, as the death toll rises to 35. The evacuation efforts were carried out by the Army's Quick Reaction Team (QRT) and other personnel. The QRT was deployed to assist in the rescue operations after heavy rains caused widespread flooding in the region. The Army has also set up relief camps for those affected by the floods. The government has assured that all necessary measures are being taken to provide aid to the affected families.
summary_points: Over 790 people evacuated from flood-hit areas in Gujarat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Death toll rises to 35 due to heavy rains causing widespread flooding
Indian Army's Quick Reaction Team (QRT) deployed for rescue operations
Army sets up relief camps for those affected by the floods
Government assures aid will be provided to affected families
